Pursuant to the Massachusetts Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25, and Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2023, notice is hereby given that there will be a regular meeting of the Holyoke Redevelopment Authority. The meeting is being held in person and remotely according to the provisions of the Executive Order extended by Governor Healey on March 28, 2025. This meeting notice contains the link above providing the public with remote access.

The meeting is being recorded and matters listed on this agenda are those reasonably anticipated by the Chairperson which may be discussed at the meeting. Not all items listed may in fact be discussed and other items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the extent permitted by law.
